name: Dinext Hub
style: .dinext-workspace-hub { color: var(--text-color); }.dinext-workspace-hub__section { margin-bottom: 2rem; }.dinext-workspace-hub__section h3 { font-size: var(--text-lg); margin-bottom: .75rem; }.dinext-workspace-hub__cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: .75rem; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card { display: flex; gap: .75rem; align-items: flex-start; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--border-radius-md); background: var(--card-bg); color: var(--text-color); text-decoration: none; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); color: var(--text-color); text-decoration: none; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-icon { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: var(--text-color); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-icon .icon, .dinext-workspace-hub__card-icon .es-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; min-width: 1.25rem; min-height: 1.25rem; --icon-stroke: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-icon .icon use, .dinext-workspace-hub__card-icon .es-icon use { stroke: var(--icon-stroke, currentColor); fill: transparent; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-body { min-width: 0; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-title { font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card:hover .dinext-workspace-hub__card-title { text-decoration: underline; }.dinext-workspace-hub__card-description { margin-top: .35rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs, 11px); text-decoration: none; }
